serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Specset is the AI platform for high-stakes construction. The Specset Cloud Platform automates technical review across Project Manuals, Drawing Sheets, and Shop Drawings — including submittal review against project specifications, UFGS compliance checking, design review automation, and asset management logic — flagging potential issues and delivering fast, accurate answers across project documents in seconds.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Specset Trust Center. The landing page, compliance posture summary, and FedRAMP milestone information are publicly viewable without authentication.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page at https://trust.specset.com is publicly accessible with no login. FedRAMP Certification Data (Certification Package Overview, Security Decision Record, Ongoing Certification Reports, policies, and the SOC 2 Type II report) is available to FedRAMP staff and agency customers on request from the Trust Center page; access is granted without requiring acceptance of terms or a non-disclosure agreement, normally within one business day. If access is not granted, contact security@specset.com. All information required by FedRAMP CDS-CSO-PUB is published without authentication at https://specset.com/fedramp/ and https://specset.com/fedramp/fedramp.json.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The Specset Cloud Platform is a single multi-tenant SaaS service for construction document intelligence. It ingests customer project documents (project manuals and specifications, drawing sheets, shop drawings and submittals) and provides: automated submittal review against project specifications; UFGS and specification compliance checking; design review automation; document search and question answering across a project's documents; and asset management logic. Customers access the service through a web application; optional customer-initiated integrations connect to the customer's own Procore or Autodesk tenants. Production is hosted on Google Cloud Platform (us-west1, Assured Workloads) with supporting services on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure as listed under third-party information resources.

certified.useCase: Google Cloud Platform (Google Services) — primary hosting of all production infrastructure: GKE Autopilot, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Memorystore, Cloud KMS, Cloud Load Balancing and Cloud Armor, Cloud Logging and Monitoring, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, and Vertex AI (Gemini) model inference and embeddings, including Web Grounding for Enterprise (web search for organizations flagged as handling CUI). Stores and processes customer data.

AWS US East/West — supporting services: Amazon SES (transactional email), Route 53 (DNS), S3 (database backups, CI cache, audit-log storage), GuardDuty (threat detection), and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model inference; may process customer document text in prompts).

Azure Commercial Cloud — Azure OpenAI (GPT model inference; may process customer document text in prompts) and Microsoft Entra ID application registrations for customer 'Sign in with Microsoft' single sign-on. No customer data is stored on Azure.
Google Workspace — provider identity (Cloud Identity) for administrator access to production via Identity-Aware Proxy; administrator email. No customer data.
GitHub Enterprise Cloud — source control and CI/CD for the application and infrastructure-as-code; deploys to production via OpenID Connect workload identity federation. No customer data.

Vanta Trust Management Platform — continuous configuration monitoring of the production cloud accounts (read-only metadata), compliance evidence, and the Specset Trust Center at trust.specset.com. No customer data.
Slack — operational alerting and change-notification channel for the provider (infrastructure change notifications, security alerts). Resource metadata only; no customer data.

Perplexity Enterprise and API Platform (FedRAMP Certified, Class B / Low) — web search for AI agent features of commercial organizations. Receives search queries; customer documents are not sent. Not used for organizations flagged as handling CUI: their web lookups run on Vertex AI Web Grounding for Enterprise inside the Google Cloud boundary.

nonCertified.name: Anthropic API (Claude)
nonCertified.useCase: Direct Claude model inference for a small set of models not served through Amazon Bedrock, selectable only by Specset administrators; prompts may include customer document text. Never enabled for organizations flagged as handling CUI.

nonCertified.name: Intercom
nonCertified.useCase: In-app customer support chat for commercial organizations. Processes customer user contact details and support conversation content; no project documents. Disabled for customer organizations flagged as handling CUI — the messenger never boots for a CUI organization and CUI memberships are never shared with it.

nonCertified.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
nonCertified.useCase: Secondary Gemini API path outside the Google Cloud FedRAMP boundary, used for evaluation. Excluded for customer organizations flagged as handling CUI; scheduled for retirement.

nonCertified.name: Better Stack
nonCertified.useCase: External uptime monitoring and the public status page (status.specbook.ai). Availability metadata only; no customer data.

nonCertified.name: Cloudflare
nonCertified.useCase: Two uses: (1) edge fronting for the Trust Center custom hostname (trust.specset.com) as provided by Vanta — no customer data; (2) Cloudflare AI Gateway proxying experimental model traffic for commercial organizations only — excluded for customer organizations flagged as handling CUI via the per-organization routing control. The Cloudflare for Government offering is not used.

nonCertified.name: Apryse (PDFTron) SDK
nonCertified.useCase: Document rendering SDK embedded in the application; only license-validation pings leave the environment. No customer data.

nonCertified.name: Autodesk Platform Services
nonCertified.useCase: Optional customer-initiated integration to the customer's own Autodesk tenant via OAuth; data exchanged is chosen and authorized by the customer. Not used unless a customer connects it.

nonCertified.name: Procore
nonCertified.useCase: Optional customer-initiated integration to the customer's own Procore tenant via OAuth; data exchanged is chosen and authorized by the customer. Not used unless a customer connects it.
